I think there was a lot more parts of my game I could have showed that I ended up showing later on obviously that I could have when I had the light to do certain shit, I should have took it instead of like minimizing my game and keeping it simple.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart and Jalen Brunson discuss the difficulty of holiday gift-giving
quotes.excerpt: between games, travel, and everything else, you blink and boom, it's Christmas.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: Have you started to think about how to gift yet? Between games, travel, and everything else, you blink and boom, it's Christmas.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: Yeah, for real. And then you got to figure out what you're going to get everybody, especially the wives. Man, you know they can be hard to shop for.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart and Jalen Brunson on gifting Tommy John products
quotes.excerpt: some of the best gifts are things people actually use, like Tommy John.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: Honestly, I feel like some of the best gifts are things people actually use, like Tommy John. It's something you can get for your wife, your family, or even yourself.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: Exactly. They have their second skin underwear, which is super soft and lightweight, plus pajamas and loungewear pieces. And with how much we're on the move during the season, having something comfortable to put on when you finally get home is a game-changer.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart and Jalen Brunson on the comfort of Tommy John
quotes.excerpt: sometimes the best part of the day is getting home. You know what else, bro? Putting on my Tommy John.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: Sometimes the best part of the day is getting home. You know what else, bro? Putting on my Tommy John.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: Exactly. If you're getting everybody else gifts, don't forget about yourself. You deserve an upgrade too. Get your wife something nice, but also grab something for yourself. Everybody wins.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on the importance of reliable network connectivity
quotes.excerpt: on the court, connection is everything. It's knowing where my teammate is without even looking.
quotes.quote: On the court, connection is everything. It's knowing where my teammate is without even looking. It's knowing if the defense collapses, someone's in the corner for three. Off the court, connection matters just as much. Imagine trying to video call your family from the hotel, text the team about practice, and reply to the 12 posts Josh sent in dinner. It's a lot, bro.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart and Jalen Brunson on the importance of quality bedding
quotes.excerpt: once you actually care about your bed, you start noticing the little things: the sheets, the pillows, the blanket.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: You know what I've been thinking about way more now than I used to? My bed.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: I mean, that actually tracks. Once you actually care about your bed, you start noticing the little things: the sheets, the pillows, the blanket. All of it.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: That's why we upgraded with Boll & Branch. Their signature organic cotton sheets are breathable, really soft, and 94% of customers say they get softer with every wash. We got the waffle blanket too. That was a good decision. Ally is also very obsessed.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on using DoorDash for basketball game reactions
quotes.excerpt: use DoorDash as your own personal reaction machine.
quotes.quote: You know me, when watching a basketball game and someone scores a big bucket and you think, what if I send my friend a big five-gallon bucket just to make a point? Well, you should, with DoorDash. In fact, use DoorDash as your own personal reaction machine. Send them some napkins when the team double dribbles, send them some glass cleaner to help with those screens, send them a clam chowder when the superstar moves to another team for you, Mitch. You get the idea. Whatever chaos you want to create, DoorDash is with you all basketball season long.
